metadata.scenario: A VIP customer questions an unexpected late fee added to their bill despite timely payments. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: vip.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is David Anderson. I’m calling about a billing issue I noticed on our latest statement. Hi David, I’m happy to help. Can you tell me more about the issue? Well, I saw an unexpected late fee added to my bill, but I’ve been making timely payments. It just doesn’t seem right. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account so I can look into this for you. Thank you, I appreciate it. It’s just frustrating because we’ve relied on your services for my wife’s recovery. I completely understand, and I appreciate your loyalty. One moment while I check your account details. Okay, I see the late fee you’re referring to. It appears there was a delay in processing one of your payments, which resulted in the charge. But I sent that payment on time! Are you sure there wasn’t an error on your end? Let me review the payment records again. I want to ensure we get this sorted out for you, David. I see that the payment was recorded a day later than it should have been. I’m very sorry for this oversight. So, what happens now? I don’t think I should be responsible for that fee. I agree, and I can certainly help with that. I’ll submit a request to waive the late fee due to this error. Thank you, I appreciate your help with this. How long will that take? It usually takes about 3-5 business days to process. I’ll follow up with you as soon as it’s resolved. That sounds good. I just want to make sure this error doesn’t happen again. Absolutely, I’ll make a note on your account to monitor this closely moving forward. Also, while I have you, my wife could really use some additional physical therapy sessions. We can certainly arrange that. Dr. Rodriguez, our physical therapist, is available to help. Great! What are the rates for those sessions? Physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 and $140 for a 45 to 60-minute visit. Okay, I’d like to schedule those. Can we discuss the details later? Of course, I’ll have Lisa, our Care Coordinator, reach out to you shortly to set that up. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You’re welcome, David. Thank you for your understanding. I’ll follow up on the billing issue and the therapy sessions soon. Sounds good. Have a great day! You too, take care!
